release_notes: Maintenance Toolkit 4.1.2 fixes update installation detection on Windows PowerShell 5.1 when an unrelated application has an invalid uninstall path. Manual verified MSI/ZIP upgrade is required on affected 4.1.1 installations. GPO owns managed deployment; no automatic reboot. Runtime UI offers seven languages with partial translations and English fallback.
